ymchweles: ymchwelut (ymchwelyd) — to return, turn back; 3 sg. preterite in -es (a ymchweles 'returned'), with a plural collective subject (Gwyr Gwyned a ymchweles 'the men of Gwynedd returned'); initial y, so the relative a shows no mutation
dracheuyn: tracheuyn (trachefn, drachefn) — back, again; adverb (ymchweles dracheuyn 'returned back'); soft-mutated (t>d), the softened form being the usual one in adverbial use
orawenus: gorawenus (gorawenus) — exultant, overjoyed (gorawen 'great joy' + -us); adjective (yn llawen orawenus 'glad, exultant'); soft-mutated (g lost) as the second adjective of the pair after adverbial yn
wystlyssant: gwystlaw (gwystlo) — to pledge, give as hostage; 3 pl. preterite in -yssant (a wystlyssant in ar tangneued 'whom they pledged to us as surety for the peace'); soft-mutated (g lost) after the relative particle a
garcharu: carcharu (carcharu) — to imprison; verbal noun, soft-mutated (c>g) after y 'his', the possessive standing for the object (ny dylywn y garcharu 'we ought not imprison him')
rydhaer: rydhau (rhyddhau) — to free, release; impersonal present subjunctive in -aer, used as a command (Rydhaer ynteu 'then let him be freed'); r written for rh, no mutation
gwystlon: gwystl (gwystl) — hostage, pledge; noun m., plural gwystlon (a'r gwystlon oed gyt ac ef 'and the hostages who were with him'); radical after the article 'r
ellyngwyt: gollwng (gellwng, gollwng) — to release, let go; impersonal preterite 'was released' (a ellyngwyt yn ol guyr y Deheu 'was let go after the men of the South'); g lost by soft mutation after a (the particle after a fronted subject)
enteu: ynteu (yntau) — he for his part; conjunctive 3 sg. m. pronoun, here spelt enteu (Enteu Math a gyrchwys 'and Math, for his part, made for'); no mutation
caer: caer (caer) — fortress, walled court; noun f.; first element of the place-name Caer Tathyl, Math's court (Caer Dathyl); radical as object after a gyrchwys
uuassynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. pluperfect 'they had been' (a uuassynt gyt ac ef 'who had been with him'); soft-mutated (b>u) after the relative particle a
gnotayssynt: gnotau (gnotáu) — to be accustomed, be wont (gnawt 'customary'); 3 pl. pluperfect 'they had been accustomed' (mal y gnotayssynt 'as they had been wont'); radical after the particle y (gn- is the word's own beginning)
gyrchu: cyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, go to; verbal noun, soft-mutated (c>g) after heb 'without' (heb gyrchu y llys 'without going to the court')
kyweiraw: cyweirio (cyweirio) — to prepare, arrange, set in order; verbal noun (a beris kyweiraw lle idaw 'and had a place made ready for him'; eu kyweiraw 'dress them'); no mutation (object/complement of peri, and after eu)
benelinyaw: penelinyaw (penelinio) — to lean on the elbow, recline (penelin 'elbow'); verbal noun, soft-mutated (p>b) after y 'to' (lle idaw y benelinyaw 'a place for him to recline')
plyc: plyg (plyg) — fold, bend; noun m. (ym plyc croth y uorwyn 'in the fold of the maiden's lap'); radical in spelling, the nasal mutation after yn (ym mhlyc) not written
is: is (is) — below, under; preposition (is dy draet 'under your feet'; is traed y wely 'under the feet of his bed'); no mutation
diargel: diargel (diargel) — hidden, secret (argel 'concealment', with di- strengthening, not negating); adjective used adverbially after yn (a hynny yn diargel 'and that secretly'; the Red Book has yn dirgel); the soft mutation (d>dd) after yn does not show in the spelling
buum: bot (bod) — to be; 1 sg. preterite 'I was' (ny buum distaw 'I was not silent'); b unmutated after ny
distaw: distaw (distaw) — silent, quiet; adjective, predicate after buum (ny buum distaw inheu 'nor was I silent'); no mutation
guypei: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'would know' (ny bu yn y llys nys guypei 'there was no one in the court who did not know it'); gu for gw, unmutated after the infixed 's
threis: trais (trais) — violence, force, rape; noun m. (a threis arnaf a orugant 'and violence on me they did'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after a 'and'
chywilyd: cywilydd (cywilydd) — shame, disgrace; noun m. (a chywilyd y titheu 'and shame to you too'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
gymeraf: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; 1 sg. present/future 'I will take' (mi a'th gymeraf yn wreic im 'I will take you as wife'; hwnn a gymeraf i 'this one I will take'); soft-mutated (k>g) after the infixed 'th 'you' and after the relative a with the object fronted
yng: yn (yn) — in; preposition, spelt yng before k (yng kyuyl y llys 'in the vicinity of the court'); the ng is the nasal mutation of the following c written on the preposition
kyuyl: cyfyl (cyfyl) — neighbourhood, vicinity, presence; noun m. (yng kyuyl y llys 'in the vicinity of the court'); written radical, the nasal mutation after yng being shown on the preposition only
gyuyl: cyfyl (cyfyl) — neighbourhood, vicinity, presence; noun m., soft-mutated (c>g) after y 'his' (yn y gyuyl ef 'in his presence')
doethauch: dyuot (dod) — to come; 2 pl. preterite 'you came' in -auch (y doethauch chwi 'you came'; a chan doethauch chwitheu 'and since you came'); radical after the particle y and after can 'since'
ydym: bot (bod) — to be; 1 pl. present 'we are' (i'th ewyllus yd ydym 'we are at your will'), after the preverbal particle yd; no mutation
ewyllwys: ewyllys (ewyllys) — will, wish, pleasure; noun m., spelt -wys (bei uy ewyllwys 'if it were my will'); no mutation (vowel)
chollwn: colli (colli) — to lose; 1 sg. imperfect/conditional in -wn 'I would lose' (ny chollwn o wyr ac arueu 'I would not lose in men and arms'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after ny
golleis: colli (colli) — to lose; 1 sg. preterite 'I lost' (a golleis 'what I lost'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
vyg: fy (fy) — my; possessive 1 sg., spelt vyg (v for /v/), the g being the written trace of the nasal mutation of the following k (Vyg kywilyd 'my shame'); the noun itself is left unmutated; cf. uyg
kywilyd: cywilydd (cywilydd) — shame, disgrace; noun m. (Vyg kywilyd 'my shame', object fronted); written radical, the nasal mutation shown only in vyg
dechreuaf: dechrau (dechrau) — to begin; 1 sg. present/future 'I will begin' (mi a dechreuaf boen arnawch 'I will begin a punishment on you'); d (any soft mutation after a would be dd, written d)
boen: poen (poen) — pain, torment, punishment; noun f./m., soft-mutated (p>b) as the object following the verb (mi a dechreuaf boen 'I will begin a punishment')
hutlath: hudlath (hudlath) — magic wand, enchanter's rod (hud 'magic' + llath 'rod'); noun f. (e hutlath 'the wand'; a'r hutlath 'with the wand'); radical; the sense is disputed (a wand of enchantment vs. a plain staff) and magic wand is likeliest
daran: daran (meaning unknown) — a word of unknown sense before ewic in yny uyd daran ewic 'until he became a … hind' (the Red Book yny uyd yn daran ewic, so daran is a word of its own and the White Book lacks yn); its form, base and any mutation cannot be determined; left untranslated
ewic: ewig (ewig) — hind, doe; noun f. (carw ac ewic 'a stag and a hind'; yn ewic 'as a hind'); radical
achub: achub (achub) — to seize, catch, snatch; verbal noun fronted before a wnaeth (achub y llall a wnaeth 'he seized the other'); no mutation (vowel)
mynhei: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'he might wish' (kyt mynhei dianc 'although he wanted to escape'); m unmutated after kyt
dianc: dianc (dianc) — to flee, escape; verbal noun (kyt mynhei dianc 'though he wished to escape'); radical
garw: carw (carw) — stag; noun m., here soft-mutated (c>g) as a predicate after yn 'as, into' (yny uyd yn garw 'until he becomes a stag') and after uu 'was' (a uu garw 'who was a stag'); not garw 'rough'
rwymedigaeth: rhwymedigaeth (rhwymedigaeth) — bond, bondage, obligation; noun f. (canys ywch yn rwymedigaeth 'since you are in bondage'); rh written r, unaffected by the nasal mutation after yn; sense 'under obligation' possible
gymaredic: kymaredic (cymharedig) — mated, paired (kymar 'mate'); adjective after predicative yn (a'ch bot yn gymaredic 'and your being mated'); soft-mutated (k>g) after yn
anyan: anian (anian) — nature, disposition, kind; noun f.; radical (ac yn un anyan a'r gwyduilot 'and of one nature with the wild beasts'; a'r anyan a uo y'r moch coet 'and the nature that belongs to the wild swine'); a- vowel, no mutation
gwyduilot: gwyddfil (gwyddfil, pl. gwyddfilod) — wild animal; here plural gwyduilot (gwydd 'wild' + mil 'beast'), the m of mil softened (m>f, written u) in the compound; a'r gwyduilot 'the wild beasts'; the exact sense is disputed, wild beasts likeliest; radical after the article
ywchwitheu: y (i) + chwitheu — conjugated preposition 'to you (pl.) for your part'; ywch with chwitheu added (y uot ywchwitheu 'for it to be so to you also'); no mutation
atafi: at (at) + i — 'to me'; 1 sg. conjugated preposition ataf with the echoing pronoun i written on (dowch yma atafi 'come here to me'); no mutation
odorun: godorun (uncertain) — a noise, disturbance, commotion (sense inferred from the dogs baying around it); noun m., here with g lost by soft mutation as the object after the verb (y clywei odorun 'he heard a disturbance'); the word is rare, sense uncertain
paret: pared (pared) — wall; noun m. (ydan y paret hwnn 'under this wall') (adan paret yr ystauell 'beneath the wall of the chamber'); radical
chyuarthua: cyfarthfa (cyfarthfa) — barking, baying (of hounds); noun f. (cyfarth 'bark' + -fa); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and' (a chyuarthua cwn y llys 'and the barking of the court's hounds')
godorun: godorun (uncertain) — a noise, disturbance, commotion; noun m. (cwn y llys am penn y godorun 'the court's dogs about the disturbance'); radical after the article y; sense uncertain
edrycheis: edrych (edrych) — to look; 1 sg. preterite 'I looked' (mi a edrycheis 'I looked'); no mutation (vowel)
elein: elain (elain) — fawn, young deer; noun f. (carw ac ewic ac elein 'a stag, a hind and a fawn'); radical
trillydyn: tri (tri) + llydyn (llwdn) — 'three beasts': the numeral with the singular noun llydyn 'beast, young animal' written as one word (y guelei y trillydyn 'he saw the three beasts'; trillydyn a welei 'three beasts he saw'); ll unchanged after tri
eodynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. imperfect 'they were' (sef trillydyn eodynt 'the three beasts they were'); scribal slip for oedynt, the letters transposed
cryf: cryf (cryf) — strong, stout; adjective following its noun (elein cryf 'a strong fawn'); no mutation
yrllyned: llynedd (llynedd) — last year; adverb, with yr the article fused (yr llyned 'last year': a uu yn ewic yrllyned 'who was a hind last year'); radical
yleni: eleni (eleni) — this year; adverb, spelt yleni with y- (bit uaed coed yleni 'let him be a boar this year'); no mutation
garnen: carnen (carnen; uncertain) — a wild sow or female of the wild swine (sense inferred from carnen coet 'wood-sow'); noun f.; soft-mutated (c>g) as predicate after bit and uu 'was' (bit garnen eleni 'let her be a sow this year') and after yn (yn garnen coet 'as a wood-sow'); sense uncertain
eleni: eleni (eleni) — this year; adverb (bit garnen eleni 'let be a sow this year'); no mutation
gymerafi: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; 1 sg. present/future 'I will take' with the emphatic i fused (gymeraf i: y mab hagen a gymerafi 'the boy I will take'); soft-mutated (k>g) after the relative a with the object fronted
uedydyaw: bedydyaw (bedyddio) — to baptize, name; verbal noun, soft-mutated (b>u) after y 'his' standing for the object (ac a baraf y uedydyaw 'and I will have him baptised') and as object after baraf (a baraf uedydyaw hwn 'I will have this one baptised')
hydwn: Hydwn (Hyddwn) — personal name, the first of the three sons, borne by Gilfaethwy as the hind (the fawn of the first year), from hyd 'stag' (d = /ð/); radical (Sef enw a dodet arnaw, Hydwn 'the name that was put on him, Hyddwn')
lleill: lleill (lleill) — 'the others', plural of llall; here, paired with a'r llall 'and the other', standing for y naill 'the one' (a bydwch y lleill yn uaed coed, a'r llall yn garnen coet 'and be the one a wild boar and the other a wild sow'; the Red Book has the same); radical after the article
ydan: dan (dan) — under, beneath; preposition, the older form with y- (ydan y paret 'under the wall'; ydan y paret hwnn 'under this wall'); no mutation
clywyn: clywet (clywed) — to hear; a scribal slip kept as written, either for clywynt 3 pl. imperfect 'they heard' (the Red Book's reading) or for clywei 3 sg. 'he heard', as in the other two years (llyma y clywyn kyuarthua cwn 'behold … heard the baying of dogs'); which is meant is not certain
kyuarthua: cyfarthfa (cyfarthfa) — barking, baying (of hounds); noun f.; radical (object of the verb, llyma y clywyn kyuarthua cwn 'he heard the baying of dogs')
lydnot: llwdn (llwdn) — young animal, beast; plural llydnot 'beasts' (sef kyfryw lydnot a welei 'the kind of beasts he saw'); soft-mutated (ll>l) after kyfryw
charnen: carnen (carnen; uncertain) — a wild sow, female of the wild swine; noun f. (a charnen coet 'and a wood-sow'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
chrynllwdyn: crynllwdyn (cryn + llwdn) — a well-grown young beast (cryn 'considerable, fair-sized' + llwdyn 'young animal'); noun m. (a chrynllwdyn da y gyt ac wy 'and a fine young beast with them'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
breisc: breisc (braisg) — stout, thick, big; adjective, fronted predicate (a breisc oed yn yr oet oed arnaw 'and big he was for his age'); radical
daraw: taraw (taro) — to strike; verbal noun, soft-mutated (t>d) after y 'his' standing for the object (a'y daraw a'r hutlath 'and striking him with the wand')
braswineu: braswineu (uncertain; bras 'stout' + gwineu 'chestnut, brown') — stout and auburn (-haired); adjective compound, gwineu soft-mutated (g lost) as its second element (mab braswineu telediw 'a handsome boy, sturdy and auburn-haired'); whether bras describes the boy or the depth of the colour is uncertain
hychdwn: Hychdwn — personal name, one of the three sons of Gilfaethwy, born as a young pig (perhaps from hwch 'sow'; uncertain); radical (Hychdwn Hir 'Hychdwn the Tall')
bleidast: bleidast (bleiddast) — she-wolf; noun f. (bleid + -ast); written unsoftened after bit, where soft mutation is expected (bit bleidast yleni 'let him be a she-wolf this year'; the Red Book bit uleidast), beside the softened bit uleid; radical also after uydant (bleid a bleidast 'a wolf and a she-wolf')
uleid: bleid (blaidd) — wolf; noun m., soft-mutated (b>u) as predicate after bit (bit uleid yleni 'let him be a wolf this year')
bleid: bleid (blaidd) — wolf; noun m. (llyma y guelei bleid a bleidast 'behold he saw a wolf and a she-wolf'); radical as object and as predicate after uydant
chywei: clywet (clywed) — to hear; 3 sg. imperfect 'he heard'; scribal slip kept, ch for the cl- of clywei (llyma y chywei dygyuor 'behold he heard a muster')
chrubothon: crubothon (meaning disputed) — a word found only here; by the context the young of the wolves, a cub (a chrubothon cryf 'and a strong cub'); its formation is obscure; spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
bleidwn: Bleidwn — personal name, the third son of Gilfaethwy, born as a wolf-cub (from bleidd 'wolf' + -wn); radical (Sef yw hwnnw, Bleidwn 'that one is Bleidwn')
enwir: enwir (anwir) — false, wicked (an- 'not' + gwir 'true'); adjective qualifying the name before it (Tri meib Giluaethwy enwir 'three sons of Gilfaethwy the false'), set against kywir; no mutation
chenryssedat: kenryssedat (meaning disputed) — a word of unsettled form and meaning in tri chenryssedat kywir 'three … true'; 'warriors' is a guess from the context; spirant-mutated (k>ch) after tri 'three'
cnawt: cnawd (cnawd) — flesh, body; noun m. (yn eu cnawt eu hun 'in their own flesh/bodies'); radical after eu 'their'
gwnaethauch: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 2 pl. preterite 'you did' in -auch (o gwnaethauch gam ymi 'if you did wrong to me'); radical after o 'if'
buawch: bot (bod) — to be; 2 pl. preterite 'you were' in -awch (digawn y buawch ym poen 'enough have you been in pain'); b unmutated after the particle y
gawssawch: kaffael (cael) — to get, receive; 2 pl. preterite 'you got' in -sawch (a chywilyd mawr a gawssawch 'and great shame you got'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
perwch: peri (peri) — to cause, have done; 2 pl. imperative 'have, cause' (Perwch enneint y'r gwyr 'have a bath made ready for the men'); no mutation
enneint: enneint (ennaint) — bath, bathing (the Middle Welsh sense; later 'ointment'); noun m. (Perwch enneint y'r gwyr 'have a bath made ready for the men'); no mutation, object of perwch
golchi: golchi (golchi) — to wash; verbal noun (a golchi eu penneu 'and washing their heads'); radical after a 'and'
berit: peri (peri) — to cause, have done; impersonal imperfect in -it 'was caused, was done' (a hynny a berit udunt 'and that was done for them'); soft-mutated (p>b) after the relative a
ohonut: o (o) + wynt — 'of them, by them'; 3 pl. conjugated preposition, a scribal slip kept for ohonunt (n missing); agent after the verbal noun (a guedy ymgueiraw ohonut 'and after their dressing themselves'); no mutation
gawsawch: kaffael (cael) — to get, receive; 2 pl. preterite 'you got' (tangneued a gawsawch 'peace you got'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a with the object fronted
cherennyd: cerennydd (cerennydd) — friendship, kinship, love; noun m./f.; spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and' (a cherennyd a geffwch 'and friendship you shall have')
geffwch: kaffael (cael) — to get, receive; 2 pl. present/future 'you will get' in -wch (a cherennyd a geffwch 'and friendship you will have'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a, the object fronted
rodwch: rodi (rhoddi, rhoi) — to give; 2 pl. imperative 'give' (A rodwch im kynghor 'and give me counsel'); r written for rh, no mutation
geisswyf: keissyaw (ceisio) — to seek, look for; 1 sg. present subjunctive 'I may seek' (pa uorwyn a geisswyf 'which maiden shall I seek'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
gynghori: cynghori (cynghori) — to advise, counsel; verbal noun, soft-mutated (c>g) after dy 'your' standing for the object (hawd yw dy gynghori 'it is easy to advise you')
aranrot: Aranrot (Arianrhod) — personal name, Gwydion's sister, daughter of Don (Aranrot uerch Don 'Aranrhod daughter of Don'); radical
nith: nith (nith) — niece; noun f. (dy nith uerch dy chwaer 'your niece, your sister's daughter'); no mutation (n is not mutated)
gyrchwyt: cyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, fetch, bring; 3 sg. impersonal preterite 'was fetched, was brought' (Honno a gyrchwyt attaw 'she was brought to him'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
chamu: camu (camu) — to bend, crook; verbal noun, spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a'y, the feminine 'y 'her, it' standing for the object, the hutlath (llath f.) (a'y chamu 'and bent it'); the same in sound as camu 'to step' of the next sentence
camha: camu (camu) — to step; 2 sg. imperative 'step' in -ha (Camha di dros honn 'step over this'); radical
ednebydaf: adnabot (adnabod) — to recognise, know; 1 sg. future 'I will know' (ot wyt uorwyn mi a ednebydaf 'if you are a maiden I will know'); no mutation (vowel), after a
camawd: camu (camu) — to step; 3 sg. preterite 'she stepped' in -awd (Yna y camawd hitheu dros yr hutlath 'then she stepped over the wand'); radical after the particle y
brasuelyn: brasfelyn (uncertain; bras 'stout, big' + melyn 'yellow') — stout and yellow(-haired); adjective compounded, melyn soft-mutated (m>f, written u) as the second element (mab brasuelyn mawr 'a big, stout, yellow-haired boy'); sense uncertain
diaspat: diasbad (diasbad) — cry, shout, outcry; noun m. (dodi diaspat uchel 'to give a loud cry'); radical as object of dodi
bethan: pethan (pethan) — a little thing (peth 'thing' + diminutive -an); noun m. (adaw y ryw bethan ohonei 'some little thing dropped from her'); soft-mutated (p>b) after ryw
olwc: golwg (golwg) — sight, look, glance; noun m./f. (yr eil olwc arnaw 'the second look at it'); g lost by soft mutation after eil 'second'
droes: troi (troi) — to turn, throw, cast; 3 sg. preterite 'he turned, threw' (ac a droes llen o bali yn y gylch 'and threw a cloth of brocade about it'); soft-mutated (t>d) after a
cudyawd: cuddio (cuddio) — to hide, conceal; 3 sg. preterite 'he hid' in -awd (a'e cudyawd 'and hid him'; sef y cudyawd 'this is where he hid him'); radical after infixed 'e and after the particle y
gist: kist (cist) — chest; noun f. (ymywn llaw gist 'inside a hand-chest', a small chest); soft-mutated (k>g) as the second element of the compound llaw gist
traed: troed (troed) — foot; noun f., plural traed (is traed y wely 'under the feet of his bed'); radical after is
dylan: Dylan — personal name, the first child born of Aranrot, named Dylan Eil Ton; radical (Sef enw a baraf, Dylan 'the name I will give is Dylan')
bedydywyt: bedydyaw (bedyddio) — to baptize, name; 3 sg. impersonal preterite 'was baptised' (y gyt ac y bedydywyt 'as soon as he was baptised'); b unmutated after the particle y
annyan: anian (anian) — nature, character; noun f. (annyan y mor a gauas 'he got the nature of the sea'); radical, object fronted before a gauas
chystal: cystal (cystal) — as good, as well; equative of da (a chystal y nouyei a'r pysc goreu 'and as well did he swim as the best fish'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
nouyei: nofio (nofio) — to swim; 3 sg. imperfect 'he swam, would swim' (a chystal y nouyei 'and as well as he swam'); n unmutated after the particle y
pysc: pysg (pysg) — fish; noun m., collective (a'r pysc goreu yn y mor 'as the best fish in the sea'); radical after a'r
ton: ton (ton) — wave; noun f. (Dylan Eil Ton; eil 'second' or 'son, offspring', the sense of the name disputed); radical in a name
thorres: torri (torri) — to break; 3 sg. preterite 'broke' (Ny thorres tonn adanaw eiryoet 'no wave ever broke under him'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after ny
tonn: ton (ton) — wave; noun f.; subject, written tonn (Ny thorres tonn 'no wave broke'); radical after the verb
adanaw: dan (dan) — under; 3 sg. m. conjugated preposition 'under him' in the older form adanaw (modern odano); no mutation
ergyt: ergyd (ergyd) — blow, stroke, shot; noun (a'r ergyt y doeth y angheu ohonaw 'and the blow by which his death came from him'; trydyd anuat ergyt 'the third ill-fated blow', one of three); radical; gender uncertain (f. in later Welsh)
uyrywys: bwrw (bwrw) — to cast, throw, strike; 3 sg. preterite in -wys on the stem byry- 'cast' (a uyrywys Gouannon 'that Gofannon cast'; the Red Book a uyryawd); soft-mutated (b>u) after the relative a
gouannon: Gouannon (Gofannon) — personal name, Dylan's uncle (the name from gof 'smith'); radical as subject after the verb (a uyrywys Gouannon y ewythyr 'which Gouannon his uncle dealt')
ewythyr: ewythr (ewythr) — uncle; noun m. (Gouannon y ewythyr 'Gouannon his uncle'); no mutation after y 'his' (vowel)

__broaden__.yn: yn — (1) 'in' (yn Arberth; nasal mutation: yn nyblyc); (2) predicative 'as' with soft mutation (yn wisc hela, yn arglwyd); (3) with a verbal noun, progressive (yn dyuot 'coming'); (4) before an adjective, adverbial (yn llawen 'gladly') · (5) yn yd 'to where' (ymchwelut yn yd oed Pwyll 'returning to where Pwyll was') · also yn yd 'as, while, when' (Ac yn yd aeth pawb ym pen yr arueu 'and while all went to arms'; the sense uncertain) · also 'our', a spelling of an (ein), with no mutation (yn anniuer ninheu 'our own company'; yn ymborth 'our sustenance'; yn diuetha 'our destroying') · also 'into' with rithyaw (eu rithyaw yn llygot 'to change them into mice') · yn ol 'after' (yn ol guyr y Deheu 'after the men of the South'); yn + predicate with verbs of becoming, 'into, as' (yny uyd yn garw 'until he becomes a stag'; yn uab braswineu telediw 'into a boy'); yn y lle 'at once'; yn y taraw wynteu 'in their striking', striking them (y here for eu 'their', yn 'in')
__broaden__.y: y — (1) the article 'the' (y llys); (2) 'his, her, its' (y uryt: soft mutation = his; y hymdidan: h-prefix = her); (3) 'to' (y hela, y gyuoeth); (4) preverbal particle after a fronted adverb or object (yno y bu, Pwyll... a oed); (5) the relative in oblique relations (o'r a welsei) · (6) 'from' in y gan, y wrth 'from, compared with' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'; y wrth y ffryt hi 'compared with her form'); (7) infixed object 'him, her, it' after a (a'y guelei 'who saw her'); (8) in a'y kymriw it is the second letter of ae 'either' (see a) · also (9) y am, y amdanaw 'from about, off' (y amdanaw 'off him'); y am hynny 'around that, beyond that, besides' · also (10) 'their' (for eu), with no mutation (y bot 'their being'; y kymryt 'their taking' = to take them) · also (11) 'in' (y'th wlat ti 'in your country') · (12) the particle y before mae introducing a reported fact (y may brawt … a wnaeth hynny 'that it is a brother who did that') · also (13) for predicative yn 'as', with soft mutation (Mi a rodaf Duw y uach it 'I give God as surety to you'; the Red Book yn vach) · (14) y ar 'from off' (y ar seith cantref Dyuet 'from off the seven cantrefs of Dyfed') · also y 'its, his' before a verbal noun, standing for the noun's object and softening it (na'y werthu 'nor selling it'; na'y ollwng 'nor releasing it') · y hediw 'from today' (a blwydyn y hediw 'and a year from today'); y 'to' before a verbal noun of purpose (lle idaw y benelinyaw 'a place for him to recline'); y 'his' twice in ar y bwyt a'y llynn 'on his food and his drink'
__broaden__.uath: Math — personal name; soft-mutated (M>u) after at 'to' and ar 'on, to' (at Uath; ar Uath uab Mathonwy) and in yguelei Uath (cause there uncertain) · also soft after wrth 'to' (heb y Guydyon wrth Uath 'said Gwydion to Math') and as subject after enteu (Enteu Uath a gyrchwys e ystauell 'and Math made for his chamber'; cause of the soft uncertain)
__broaden__.ollwng: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; verbal noun (na'y ollwng nas gwnaf i 'nor releasing it will I do'); g lost by soft mutation after 'y 'its', the possessive standing for the object · also verbal noun as subject of iawn, after ynni, g lost (ponyt oed iawn ynni ollwng eu dylyedauc 'would it not be right for us to release their nobleman'; mutation after the conjugated preposition ynni, cause uncertain)
__broaden__.eu: eu — 'their'; possessive pronoun (eu clusteu 'their ears') · also 'them' (object) before a verbal noun (ar hynny eu taraw a'r hutlath 'and thereupon striking them with the wand'; eu kyweiraw 'dressing them')
__broaden__.ac: a — 'and' before a vowel (ac ef); also the preposition a 'with' before a vowel (ymgael ac ef 'meet with him', ymordiwes ac ef) · the manuscript also writes ac before some consonants (Ac wal, Ac val, ac racdaw) · also 'as' after an equative or kymeint (kymeint ac ynot ti 'as much as in you'; mor anwedus ac ar y wnaethoed 'as unseemly as what she had done') · y gyt ac y + verb, 'as soon as' (y gyt ac y bedydywyt 'as soon as he was baptised'; y gyt ac y doeth y'r mor 'as soon as he came to the sea')
__broaden__.gyt: kyt (cyd) — together; in y gyt (a) 'together (with)' (y gyt ac wynt 'together with them') · y gyt ac y + verb 'as soon as' (y gyt ac y doeth y'r mor 'as soon as he came to the sea'); y gyt without a, 'together, as one' (ywch gerdet y gyt 'you to go together'); y gyt a chwi 'with you'
__broaden__.gyrchwys: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, head towards; 3 sg. preterite, soft-mutated after y (y gyrchwys 'he made for') · also soft-mutated after the relative particle a with the object fronted (y gaer a gyrchwys ef 'the fort he made for') · also soft after a with the subject fronted (Enteu Math a gyrchwys Caer Tathyl 'and Math made for Caer Dathyl'; y mor a gyrchwys 'he made for the sea')
__broaden__.gylchaw: kylchu (cylchu) — to go round, make a circuit; verbal noun, spelt kylchaw (o gylchaw Dyuet 'from going round Dyfed'); soft-mutated (k>g) after the preposition o 'from' · also y gylchaw 'round about', the verbal noun after y used as a preposition (a gyrchyssant y gylchaw Gwyned 'went round about Gwynedd'; trigyaw y gylchaw y wlat 'staying round about the land'), soft-mutated (k>g) after y
__broaden__.lle: lle (lle) — place; noun m., base unmutated form · yn y lle 'at once, on the spot' (Ac yn y lle, y gyt ac y doeth y'r mor 'and at once, as soon as he came to the sea'); lle idaw y benelinyaw 'a place for him to recline'
__broaden__.caei: kaffael (cael) — to get; 3 sg. imperfect 'could get, would get' (ny caei graf 'he could get no grip'); no mutation shown after ny (a spirant mutation, ny chaei, would be expected) · auxiliary 'might, be allowed to' + verbal noun (ual y caei dodi y draet 'so that he might put his feet')
__broaden__.draet: troet (troed) — foot; plural traet (traed), soft-mutated (t > d) after y 'his' (am y draet 'on his feet') · also soft after dy 'your' (is dy draet 'under your feet')
__broaden__.uorwyn: morwyn (morwyn) — maiden; noun f., soft-mutated in address (A uorwyn 'O maiden'), after the article (y uorwyn 'the maiden') and after o (o uorwyn 'of maiden') · also soft after am 'about' (am uorwyn kystal 'about a maiden so good') · also soft after predicative yn (yn uorwyn gyt ac ef 'as a maiden with him') · also soft as object after an imperative (keis uorwyn 'seek a maiden'), after pa 'which' (pa uorwyn a geisswyf 'which maiden shall I seek') and as predicate after bot (a wyt uorwyn di 'are you a maiden?'; ot wyt uorwyn 'if you are a maiden')
__broaden__.wely: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 2 sg. present 'you will see', soft-mutated after a (ti a wely a wneuthum i yrot ti) · also in the presentative (a) wely di 'do you see?' = 'behold' (Ac wely dy yna dy uab 'and there, behold, is your son'; the Red Book has weldy), softened after the question particle a, which is absorbed · gwely (gwely) — bed; noun m., g lost by soft mutation after 'th 'your' and y 'his' (i'th wely 'in your bed'; traed y wely 'the feet of his bed')
__broaden__.gyntaf: kyntaf (cyntaf) — first; superlative, soft-mutated after y (ar y gossot kyntaf 'at the first onset') · also adverbial 'fastest, soonest' (ual y gallei gyntaf 'as fast as he could') · also soft after a feminine noun (y nos gyntaf 'the first night') · soft after yn, 'first, at first' (iawn y ti yn gyntaf 'redress to you first'; yn gyntaf ny doethant wy 'at first they did not come')
__broaden__.uedyant: medyant (meddiant) — possession, power; noun m., soft-mutated after y 'his/your' (yn y uedyant, i'th uedyant) · also soft as the object after the verb (a rodaf uedyant uyg kyuoeth 'and I will give possession of my realm')
__broaden__.ywch: y (i) + chwi — 'to you'; conjugated preposition, 2 pl. (rodo da ywch 'may he give good to you'); no mutation · bot (bod) — to be; 2 pl. present 'you are' (canys ywch yn rwymedigaeth 'since you are in bondage'; yd ywch yn eu rith 'you are in their shape')
__broaden__.gerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — going, pace; verbal noun/noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y gerdet 'to go'), after vn 'same' (vn gerdet; why is not clear, kerdet being usually masculine), and in amgen urys gerdet 'other haste of pace' (cause unclear) · also soft-mutated after pa 'what' (pa gerdet yssyd arnawch chwi 'what journey is on you?') and after llyna (Llyna gerdet 'there is the journey') · also soft after ar 'on' (ar gerdet 'on the move, walking') · also soft after in 'for us' (reit yw in gerdet 'it is necessary for us to go') · also soft after ywch 'to you' (mi a wnaf ywch gerdet y gyt 'I will make you go together'; verbal noun after the conjugated preposition)
__broaden__.ch: ych (eich) — 'your' (pl.), infixed after y: y'ch (y'ch kynnal chwi 'to maintain you') · also the object 'you' (pl.) after a (mi a'ch differaf 'I will protect you') · a'ch bot yn gymaredic 'and that you be matched', 'ch 'your' before a verbal noun
__broaden__.bit: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperative 'let there be, let it be' (A bit corn canu da 'and let there be a good horn for blowing'; bit hynny yn arwyd 'let that be the signal'); modern bydded · also introducing a predicate noun, which it softens (bit uaed coed 'let (him) be a wild boar'; bit uleid 'let him be a wolf')
__broaden__.uaed: baed (baedd) — boar; noun m.; soft-mutated (b>u, = f) after the presentative llyma (llyma uaed coed 'behold a boar of the wood') · also soft as predicate after bit (bit uaed coed yleni 'let him be a boar this year') and after yn (yn uaed coed 'as a boar')
__broaden__.ueithryn: meithryn (meithrin) — to foster, rear; verbal noun (am ueithryn y mab 'for fostering the boy'); soft-mutated (m>u) after the preposition am · also soft after y 'his', standing for the object (ac a baraf y ueithryn 'and I will have him fostered')
__broaden__.oet: oet (oed) — appointed time, tryst; noun m. (y mae oet y rof i ac ef 'there is an appointment between me and him') · also a spelling of oed 'was', 3 sg. imperfect of bot (yn yd oet Pwyll 'where Pwyll was') · also 'time of life, age' (a breisc oed yn yr oet oed arnaw 'and big he was for his age')
__broaden__.hir: hir (hir) — long; adjective (yn hir 'for a long time') · also the epithet in a name (Hychdwn Hir 'Hychdwn the Tall/Long')
__broaden__.uerch: merch (merch) — daughter, girl; noun f., softened after a woman's name (Riannon uerch Heueyd 'Rhiannon daughter of Hefeydd') · also soft after predicative yn (yn uerch y urenhin 'as daughter to the king') · also soft in apposition after a common noun (dy nith uerch dy chwaer 'your niece, daughter of your sister')
__broaden__.ni: ni — (1) 1 pl. pronoun 'we/us' (yd ymdidanyssam ni); (2) negative particle, spelling variant of ny before some verbs (ni ladaf, ni bu) · also a scribal slip here for the emphatic i (Ny wnn ni amgen no'm bot 'I know no other than that I am (a maiden)'); the n of wnn written twice
__broaden__.cam: cam (cam) — wrong, injustice; noun m. (cam a wnaeth 'he did wrong'); no mutation (fronted object) · also cam 'step, pace' (ar y cam hwnnw 'at that step')
__broaden__.eil: eil (ail) — second; ordinal numeral (yr eil 'the second') · also in the name Dylan Eil Ton, eil 'second' or 'son, offspring' (sense of the epithet disputed)
__broaden__.hynny: hynny — 'that (thing)'; demonstrative pronoun, very frequent (a hynny 'and that') · also adjective 'those' after its noun (a'r tri hynny 'and those three'); yn hynny 'in that (time), meanwhile' (Ac yn hynny ny doethant wy 'meanwhile they did not come')
__broaden__.llaw: llaw (llaw) — hand; noun f., in the idiom uch llaw 'above, overlooking' (uch llaw y llys 'above the court') · also gyr llaw 'beside, next to' (eisted gyr llaw hwnnw 'to sit beside it') · also 'hand' without mutation after the article y (yn y llaw arall 'in the other hand') · also first element of the compound llaw gist 'hand-chest', a small chest (ymywn llaw gist 'inside a small chest')
__broaden__.tri: tri (tri) — three (m.); numeral (dyuot tri ederyn 'there came three birds'); no mutation · also causes spirant mutation of c, p, t (tri chenryssedat kywir 'three true …'); not of ll (trillydyn 'three beasts')
__broaden__.etiued: etifedd (etifedd) — heir; noun m. (na byd it etiued 'that you will have no heir', literally 'there will not be to you an heir'); no mutation (vowel) · also 'offspring, young' of beasts (y bo etiued udunt wy 'when they have young'; ych etiued y gyt a chwi 'your young with you')
__broaden__.dowch: dyuot (dod) — to come; 2 pl. present 'you come' (o dowch 'if you come'); after o 'if' · also 2 pl. imperative 'come' (blwydyn y hediw dowch yma atafi 'a year from today come here to me')
__broaden__.e: y — 'his', spelt e before a following consonant or in some spellings: e gwn 'his dogs', e weneb 'his face'; also the preposition 'to' in e uynet 'to go' · also 'her', with h- before a vowel (e hymlit hi 'to pursue her'); the verbal particle y (e deuthum i 'I came'); y of y wrth 'from' (e wrthaw 'from him'); and in e uynyd 'up', e ymdeith 'away' · also the article 'the' (E brenhin, E chwedyl 'the king', 'the news'); 'it' as dummy subject (E doeth im 'it came to me') · also the infixed object 'him' after a (pwy a'e lladei 'who killed him'; a'e guelei 'who saw him') and 'her' with spirant mutation (a'e chladu yno 'and burying her there'); and the y of y gan 'from' (E gan Uanawydan 'from Manawydan') · also in e hun (ehun) 'self, own', unchanged for any person (eu kedymdeithon e hun 'their own companions'; synnyaw e hun 'watching for himself') · also the y of y rof 'between me' in the oath (E rof a Duw 'between me and God') · also 'his' before a vowel and before h (e ystauell 'his chamber'; e hutlath 'his magic rod')
__broaden__.trydyd: trydyd (trydydd) — third; ordinal (ar y trydyd 'at the third') · also in the triad formula, 'the third (of three)', one of a set of three (A hwnnw a uu trydyd anuat ergyt 'and that was one of the three ill-fated blows')
__broaden__.uchel: uchel (uchel) — high; adjective (ar garrec uchel 'on a high rock'); no mutation (vowel) · also 'loud' of a sound (dodi diaspat uchel 'giving a loud cry')
